sections.title: Performance Optimization Analysis
sections.content: After reviewing the codebase, I've identified several performance optimization opportunities. Here are my findings and actionable suggestions:

sections.title: Issue: MonthlyReport.tsx recalculates values on every render
sections.content: In `MonthlyReport.tsx`, the `year`, `month`, `daysInMonth`, and `monthName` variables are recalculated on every render, even though they only depend on `selectedMonth` which changes infrequently.

sections.title: Solution: Memoize expensive calculations
Issue: monthOptions array recreated on every render
sections.content: The `monthOptions` array is rebuilt on every render in `MonthlyReport.tsx`.

sections.title: Solution: Memoize the monthOptions array
Issue: No client-side caching for data fetching
sections.content: Both `Dashboard.tsx` and `MonthlyReport.tsx` refetch all data on every refresh, even if the data hasn't changed significantly.

sections.title: Solution: Implement simple caching mechanism
Issue: Excel files regenerated from scratch each time
sections.content: The export functions in `lib/excel.ts` recreate the entire Excel workbook even when exporting the same data multiple times.

sections.title: Solution: Add memoization for Excel exports
Issue: Selected option recalculated on every render
sections.content: In `Select.tsx`, `selectedOption` is recalculated on every render which could be inefficient with large option arrays.

sections.title: Solution: Memoize the selectedOption calculation
Summary of Findings
sections.content:
1. **No N+1 query patterns detected** - The code properly uses Supabase joins to fetch related data in single queries.
2. **Several unnecessary re-renders identified** - Particularly in `MonthlyReport.tsx` where values are recalculated on every render.
3. **Caching opportunities exist** - Implementing client-side caching for data exports and API responses would improve performance.
4. **No memory leaks detected** - All useEffect hooks appear to be properly cleaned up.
5. **Redundant computations found** - Specifically in date calculations and option array generation.

These optimizations would significantly improve performance, especially for users with large datasets or frequent interactions with the reporting features. The suggested changes are focused and minimal, addressing the most impactful issues without requiring major architectural changes.
